description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk Home: * 6-Seater LSV Golf Cart Included * 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Quiet Neighborhood, surrounded by bike and walking trails* 2 Private Balconies* Access to "Gathering Place" with Pools, Hammocks, Grills, Fire Pit, and Pickleball Courts* Walking or Biking Distance to Fabulous Shopping and Dining Options* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs from December through January, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Tucked away in the serene NatureWalk 30A Resort Community, Gram's Beach Spot is the perfect retreat for your next vacation. This charming home features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests. On the first floor, you’ll find an open-concept living space with a cozy sitting area and flat-screen TV, a dining table with seating for four, and a stylish kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, marble countertops, and a breakfast bar that seats three. A guest bedroom with a queen bed and private ensuite bathroom is also located on this level, offering a quiet and convenient space for relaxation. Upstairs, the spacious master suite boasts a king bed, a luxurious ensuite with a soaking tub and walk-in shower, and plenty of room to unwind. Another guest bedroom with a queen bed and a versatile loft area — featuring two twin-over-twin bunk beds and a queen sleeper sofa — makes it perfect for families or groups traveling together. Step outside onto one of the expansive balconies to sip your morning coffee or enjoy a peaceful evening under the stars. With complimentary bikes and a golf cart included, it's easy to explore everything 30A has to offer — from scenic nature trails and beach access points to charming local shops and eateries. Whether you're relaxing at the resort-style community pool, cruising along coastal paths, or sharing family meals back at the house, Gram's Beach Spot is your home base for unforgettable memories. Discover why guests return to this special spot year after year!**Please note: Strict Age Requirement of 21+ to Drive Golf Cart.*Due to an HOA restriction, boats, RVs, and trailers are not allowed in this neighborhood**Guests will be charged $150 for lost or missing amenity passes. Please leave the pass at home upon departure. *The Bed Setup1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedLoft Area: 2 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds and Queen Sleeper SofaNatureWalk 30A is ideally located on Hwy 395 off of 30A, next to Watercolor and Seaside. NatureWalk is surrounded by Point Washington State Forest, and Grayton Beach State Park and Western Lake are located right next to Watercolor. Explore the endless trails by bike or on foot. Rent a canoe or paddleboard. Visit the funky shops and restaurants in Grayton Beach town, just down 30A. Watercolor Crossings adjoins our neighborhood, with Publix, Pizza by the Sea, Boca Boutique, UPS Store, Emerald Coast Wine and Spirits, Perfect Pig restaurant, Pedego Electric Bikes, and Yellowfin Sports, for all your outdoor needs. Due to HOA restrictions, boats, RVs, and trailers are not allowed in this neighborhood.NatureWalk 30A has a private path “Lilly Lane Beach Trail” to San Juan Avenue which is less than a mile from beach access at Santa Clara Regional Beach Access. This path goes through the beautiful state forest which also surrounds NatureWalk 30A. Several additional beach accesses are also located along 30A within a mile. The beaches at Seaside or Watercolor, as well as Grayton Beach State Park, are a short bike ride or golf cart ride away.NatureWalk features “Gathering Place” which boasts a large zero-entry pool, a heated lap pool, hot tub, lounge chairs, tables and chairs, a shaded kiddie pool, hammocks, a playground, an outdoor kitchen with gas grills, and a gas fire pit for family enjoyment. You will also volleyball courts, pickleball, basketball, and another playground nearby. Guests will be charged $150 for lost or missing amenity passes. Please leave the amenity pass in the home upon departure.Area Attractions:30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.WaterColor, Florida, is a beach town with rich landscaping and incredible pocket parks that blend perfectly into Northwest Florida’s natural scrub oak and palmetto. WaterColor borders the Gulf of Mexico and Western Lake, South Walton’s largest coastal dune lake. Great care was taken to preserve the natural beauty of Western Lake. Gravel nature trails twist and wind through the oak scrub and footbridges crisscross Western Lake. On the North side of Scenic 30-A, you will find a large butterfly garden that leads to an outdoor amphitheater and boathouse. At the boathouse, try stand-up paddle-boarding, kayaking, or canoeing over towards the shores of Grayton Beach State Park. On the South side of Scenic 30-A is the WaterColor Beach Club, along with the home of the James Beard award-winning restaurant, Fish Out of Water. Community access to the Gulf of Mexico is through a beach boardwalk adjacent to the Beach Club. WaterColor Florida is a fabulous spot for your next beach vacation!Seaside is a fantastic destination within walking distance and is most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
